reviewer: OpenAI ChatGPT GPT-6 — independent review of owner-supplied exact four-line Git diff on 2026-10-12

reviewScope.summary: Independent review of four configuration-only changes in commit 5f69d1bc91b9bd052dc0fe8fb9b1fbbbe1800e08, whose parent is the published v1.8.0 review-bound commit eab80fcfaa57d7eb6d0de36f0392b78e0eeb04d9. Supports advancing to native release certification only, not a declaration of GitHub CI success or production promotion.
evidence: Owner supplied git --no-pager show --format= --unified=1 HEAD showing exactly four paths and four replacements; the same owner output reports 4 files changed, 4 insertions, 4 deletions.
Owner reported format check and Node syntax checks passed before committing; HEAD/tree were not independently fetched from private GitHub.
Owner reported candidate payload tree 9d5e2a8a40d9a92392873976a911b66eed43ec23. Release script must independently recompute it.

Earlier Linux GitHub CI release gate stopped at 20-minute Playwright global timeout after 175 tests passed and 11 unexecuted; native Windows gate passed 186 E2E. The timeout increase does not prove there is no separate Task 6 hang.

adversarialFindings.description: Increasing a global timeout does not make the E2E suite faster; 30 minutes may still be insufficient on Linux.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Bounded 30/31/32/60-minute ceilings with 1-minute nested buffers were reviewed. Require one complete green GitHub Linux gate; if still incomplete, diagnose the actual slow/hung case rather than increasing limits again.

adversarialFindings.description: A screenshot showed Task 6 during Lagrer og sjekker svaret; overall timeout does not rule out an individual saving/synchronization hang.
adversarialFindings.resolution: No test assertion failure was established. Preserve the test unchanged and require the complete 186-case Linux suite; isolate Task 6 if the same state stalls again.

adversarialFindings.description: The four timeout layers previously had inconsistent budgets for the observed Linux suite duration.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The four-line diff coordinates limits without changing product code, test count, retries, or worker configuration.

adversarialFindings.description: Vercel READY does not establish GitHub CI success or production alias promotion.
adversarialFindings.resolution: After a green remote gate, independently check Vercel checks, alias resolution at the exact SHA, and hosted learner smoke. Do not force alias promotion as a workaround.

retrospective.summary: The four-line release-runner configuration change is adequately bounded for native release certification. Approval is conditional on future exact-candidate native gate and full green remote CI; do not claim the current failed production release is complete.
